name: Shampoo
description: Shampoo-style diagonal preconditioning. foreach, fused, and capturable are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

examples.title: Optimize a model with Shampoo
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.shampoo import shampoo

model = torch.nn.Linear(4, 1)
optimizer = shampoo(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)
loss = model(torch.randn(8, 4)).square().mean()
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
